system.description: Superior thieves' tools have the same components as expanded thieves' tools but are crafted with incredible precision. They grant a +4 to proficiency throws to Lockpicking and Trapbreaking proficiency throws. If the thief rolls a natural 1 while attempting to pick a lock, the tools can make a Death saving throw (at the thief 's level) to resist breaking (see the Adventuring chapter, p. 266). The bonus does not apply to hijinks.
